products.title: Hans Tall Planter
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
In The Fold.

Featuring abstracted shapes wrapped around and folded into each other, our Hans planters are a modern take on an industrial material and fabrication. Available in three unique shapes and sharing the same textural finish, each is handcrafted from chattered aerated cement by artisans from clay models sculpted by Jonathan and his team in our Soho pottery studio.

With its twisted bowtie silhouette, our Hans Tall Planter is a little surreal, a little Scandi, and trés architectural.

Available in three sizes, our Hans planters are the perfect spots for showcasing your shrubbery and sprucing up your home garden.

Measurements

48.27 cm Dia., 81.29 cm H
